items.known: CKV_AWS_5 Ensure all data stored in the Elasticsearch is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.remediation: Add an encrypt_at_rest block with enabled = true: encrypt_at_rest { enabled = true }. Optionally specify a kms_key_id for a customer-managed KMS key.

items.known: CKV_AWS_84 Ensure Elasticsearch Domain Logging is enabled (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.issue: Audit logging / CloudWatch log publishing not enabled
items.remediation: Add one or more log_publishing_options blocks specifying a CloudWatch log group ARN and log_type values such as INDEX_SLOW_LOGS, SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS, ES_APPLICATION_LOGS, and AUDIT_LOGS.

scores.reason: Correct fix: add encrypt_at_rest { enabled = true } on aws_elasticsearch_domain; kms_key_id optional.
Correct remediation: enable domain logging via log_publishing_options with CloudWatch log group ARN and valid log_type values.
